newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker ahead of holiday.

text.p: Downward adjustment of the local currency by the central bank forced the Bangladesh taka to end weaker at 42.8100/8300 to the dollar in interbank trading on Saturday, dealers said.

The local unit was quoted at 42.7000/42.8500 per dollar in early trade. "Transactions were more than we expected initially. Many banks were seen busy in squaring up their positions ahead of the holiday," said one dealer. Call money was traded at 8.5 in early deals but rose to the previous session's level of 9.0 to 9.5 percent at the close.
The market will remain shut for the Moslem Eid al-Fitr holiday until February 12.
